rubric: Six equally weighted categories matching the prior production-readiness assessment. Mean 7.3333 rounded to 7.3. Engineering judgement, not certification or remediation completion.

categories.name: Security and access control
categories.reason: Federation and L3 fixes credited; lost revocations remain security-relevant.

categories.name: Observability and diagnosability
categories.reason: Better guidance and safe route errors; raw Indy errors and deployment evidence remain.

categories.name: Reliability and scale
categories.reason: Bounded stores and improved scans; reproduced concurrency and expansion defects remain.

categories.name: Configuration and data
categories.reason: SPI/policy fixes hold; bitmap invariants and digest integration need repair.

categories.name: Deployment and release
categories.reason: Green hosted gates and verified provenance; published-release qualification remains.

categories.name: Testing and documentation
categories.reason: Broad executed baseline and clearer limits; modest branch coverage and new failing probes.
